title: Amalek
lead: A desert people descended from Esau's grandson Amalek (Genesis 36:12), who attacked Israel after the Exodus and became the enemy Israel was told to remember. Saul's failure to destroy their king Agag cost him the throne, and Haman "the Agagite" is read as Amalek's heir (Exodus 17:8–16; Deuteronomy 25:17–19; 1 Samuel 15; Esther 3:1).
